items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: Anytime they said Popper South Stan was playing somewhere, They didn't have to worry about the people turning out. You always draw a crowd.

ctx.x: And there was a good drawing chord. Anytime they said Popper South Stan was playing somewhere, They didn't have to worry about the people turning out. You always draw a crowd.
How was the Sam Morgan band? Was that before South Stan was popular? Or were they both about the same?
